items.text: Detroit (early week, Mon estimate): DNP - S Chuck Clark (hamstring), EDGE DJ Wonnum (back), DT Skyler Gill-Howard (knee), CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder). LIMITED - TE Sam LaPorta (ankle). FULL - CB D.J. Reed, CB Khalil Dorsey. Jared Goff starts.

Chicago (early week, Mon estimate): DNP - LT Theo Benedet (quad; Ozzy Trapilo would start), CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder, missed last game), RB Roschon Johnson (ankle, carted off vs NO). FULL - LB D'Marco Jackson. Caleb Williams starts.
